tests.description: the store drops its oldest output when the next save would pass a million characters, and the name of a dropped output reads back as no longer available
a well-formed name the store never issued is a Result failure from both readers, not an error
an output evicted from the live store after a checkpoint is back after restoring that checkpoint, so the store rides in the checkpoint

a tool result over spillToolResultsOver is saved whole, though under maxToolResultChars, and the model gets a notice that gives a path and names no tool; the saved text reads back by that path, whole, by grep, and with read
offering readSpill without spillToolResultsOver does not save anything: a result over maxToolResultChars is cut with the truncation marker
spillToolResultsOver with no reader in the tools is accepted: the loop does not look at the call's tools, and the result is saved under the path its notice gives
without spillToolResultsOver, a result over the cap is cut with the truncation marker and nothing is saved
